title: How Do Chameleons Change Colour? 🦎 Fun Facts for Kids
description:
Chameleons change colour with tiny crystals in their skin! Leo asks, big sister Mia explains how it works and why they do it, in under a minute.

Curio Kids Club: short, curious answers to kids' big questions. Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@CurioKidsClub

lines.text: Mia, how do chameleons change colour?
Their skin has a secret! Under the top layer are special cells full of teeny tiny crystals.
Sort of! When a chameleon is calm, the crystals sit close together. When it gets excited, its skin stretches and they spread apart.
That changes which colours of light bounce back to our eyes. A calm chameleon might look green, and an excited one yellow or orange!
So do they change colour to hide?
Lots of people think so! But scientists say they mostly change colour to show how they feel, and to send messages to other chameleons.
So a chameleon wears its mood on its skin!
Exactly! Bright colours can say, 'This is my spot!' Darker, duller colours can say, 'I don't want any trouble.'
Do they change colour when they're cold, too?
Yes! A chameleon can turn darker to soak up more sunshine and warm up.
Tiny crystals, feelings and warming up. Chameleons are so cool!
They really are! Follow Curio Kids Club for more wonders. And next time someone asks... how do chameleons change colour?
